title: Cloud conflict resolution crashes the app
body: ### Bug description _No response_ ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a cloud project 2. Create a couple of snapshots 3. While the project is open, restore an older snapshot on audio com 4. Edit and try to save the project 5. Project version conflict dialog is shown 6. Select "Discard and open latest" 7. Unsaved changes dialog pops up. Since we already chose "discard" this is an error now, there is a fork that leads to different issues: a) On this dialog "Save" is chosen 1. You select save 2. Project conflict dialog is shown again 3. You select discard 4. Unsaved changes dialog is shown again 5. You select save 6. go to 2 Until at some point this dialog is shown on an unlimited account: 7. You are allowed to save the project locally 8. When you save it locally and close this project audacity crashes 9. local copy no longer opens 10. cloud copy no longer opens, but doesn't show an error, simply does nothing ``` #8 libc++abi
